titleIntroContent: It's time for your favorite escape
titleIntroContentText: Massages, facials, body scrubs, and more; immerse yourself in total relaxation.
titleDescriptionContent: Good health is a commitment to yourself.
titleDescriptionContentText: And our promise to you is to use our expertise and care to help you reconnect with yourself, feel confident, and embrace a healthier, more radiant version of you.
titleBasicServiceContentText: The best part of your week starts here. Our treatments are designed to enhance your well-being—so you leave renewed, revitalized, and ready to shine.
titleSpecialServiceContentText: At Moani Spa, we are dedicated to your well-being. Enjoy exclusive and rejuvenating treatments in a serene and private environment, with cutting-edge technology, high-quality products, and a team that offers warm and personalized attention.
titleProductContentText: Bring the spa experience to your home. Discover our line of products designed to help you relax and enjoy moments of calm, whenever you want.
titleVisitContentText: You deserve a perfect day, starting at Moani Spa.
titleMissionContent: To meet the needs of our clients, promoting physical and mental well-being through personalized therapies, facial and body treatments, using cutting-edge technology and highly trained staff.
titleVisionContent: To be a leading company in cosmetology, recognized for providing exceptional service and personalized attention that helps our clients achieve their wellness and beauty goals.
titleBasicServiceContentText2: Discover our essential services that provide care, relaxation, and visible results. Treatments designed to keep your skin and body healthy every day.
titleSpecialServiceContentText2: Explore advanced treatments with state-of-the-art technology to rejuvenate, firm, and transform your skin. A personalized and effective wellness experience.
titleHydraulicFacialContentText: Deeply hydrates your skin and restores its natural glow. Ideal for dehydrated and dull skin, this treatment brings back freshness and elasticity from the first session.
titlecleanFacialContentText: Removes impurities, blackheads, and dead skin cells. This facial deeply purifies your skin, leaving it soft, balanced, and visibly healthier.
titleSpecialFacialDermapenContentText: Stimulates collagen production and improves your skin's texture. Dermapen is ideal for treating acne scars, wrinkles, and enlarged pores, achieving a firmer and more even complexion.
titleSpecialFacialRadioFContentText: Activates cellular regeneration with radiofrequency technology, achieving an immediate tightening and rejuvenating effect. Perfect for combating sagging and improving facial firmness.
titleDespigmentFacialContentText: Evens out your skin tone and visibly reduces dark spots caused by sun exposure or acne. Your skin will look clearer, more radiant, and uniform.
titleAcneFacialContentText: Specifically designed for oily or acne-prone skin. Regulates sebum, reduces inflammation, and prevents new breakouts for cleaner and healthier skin.
titleDermaplaningFacialContentText: Removes dead skin cells and fine facial hair with a safe and effective technique. Your skin will appear smoother, softer, and better absorb products.
titlerelaxMassageContentText: Release stress with gentle movements that calm your body and mind. This massage is perfect for those seeking a moment of tranquility and inner harmony.
titleDescMassageContentText: Relieves localized muscle tension with deep techniques. Ideal for people with neck, back, or leg pain due to stress or poor posture.
titleReductMassageContentText: Helps shape your figure, improve circulation, and reduce fluid retention. This massage focuses on areas with localized fat accumulation.
titleLNMassageContentText: Promotes toxin elimination and improves lymphatic circulation. It's ideal for reducing swelling, cellulite, and enhancing the immune system.
titleHifuContentText: Non-surgical facial lifting with focused ultrasound technology. Tightens the skin from the deepest layers, achieving a rejuvenating and long-lasting effect.
titleMorpheusContentText: Revolutionize your skin with microneedling and radiofrequency technology. Stimulates deep regeneration, improves texture, tone, and firmness in the face and neck.
titleDepilationContentText: Forget about hair with quick, safe, and effective sessions. Diode laser technology guarantees long-lasting results and comfort in each treatment.
productDSerum: It is a depigmenting, antioxidant, and sebum-regulating serum. Suitable for all skin types. Helps to reduce spots from PIH, epidermal melasma, solar lentigines, evens skin tone, brightens, and refines skin texture.
productMSerum: Facial microbiome. Suitable for all skin types. Helps strengthen the skin barrier during periods of chronosensitivity, promotes the synthesis of vital elements to achieve healthy and strengthened skin.
productGenesis1: Day moisturizing cream for normal to dry skin. Helps hydrate the skin, reduces the appearance of spots or pigmentation, and modulates excessive oil secretion.
productGenesis2: Day moisturizing cream for normal to dry skin. Helps promote the hydrolipidic balance, improves skin hydration, and moisturizes.
productYankaC: Depigmenting cream. Suitable for all skin types. Helps capture free radicals, counteracting harmful effects on the skin, hydrates, delays the appearance of expression lines, lightens, and progressively evens skin tone.
productAxtaxantina: Antioxidant gel cream. Suitable for all skin types. Hydrates the skin, contains 8 types of hyaluronic acid, promotes collagen synthesis.
productPorcelaine50: (With color) Suitable for all skin types. Helps effectively prevent the appearance of spots and enhances the results of alternative treatments, contains a combination of highly photostable and broad-spectrum chemical sunscreens with antioxidant action.
productPorcelaine360: Mousse sunscreen (Without color). Provides antioxidant protection with 5% niacinamide and 1% marine glycogen, counteracting premature aging caused by digital pollution.
productPorcelaineP30: (With color) Suitable for all skin types. It is a 100% mineral powder sunscreen, its composition adds extra care to sun protection, thanks to its content of submicron spheres of Astaxanthin.
productSunSecure50: (Without color) For hypersensitive skin. Helps with imperfections, evens skin tone, and offers UVB and UVA protection.
productSunSecureUriage: For sensitive and sun-intolerant skin. Promises reliable and safe coverage, lightweight finish, it is a mist sunscreen.
